top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards a specific, traceable invention, the magic-wavelength optical lattice clock, whose roughly 1e-18 performance has been intercompared across independent laboratories. The two-name allocation to Katori and Ye is clean and the citation can be scoped to the lattice clock itself, distinct from the 2005 comb and 2012 single-ion control prizes. P002 (magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene) is a strong prediction-then-discovery case but I rank it second because the mechanism is unsettled and the experimental credit cannot be captured by the three proposed names. An award is preferable to no award.
recusal_note: No documented connection to Katori, Ye or the P001 laureates. My profile shows professional proximity to electronic-structure theory and magnetism, hence to the P002 field, which I have tried not to overweight; none apparent that would require recusal.
